system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: NCT06292013 - A Study to Investigate the Effect of Lepodisiran on the Reduction of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Adults With Elevated Lipoprotein(a) - ACCLAIM-Lp(a)
Investigational drug: lepodisiran sodium
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06292013 (registry, published 2024-03-04, source ctgov:NCT06292013)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT06292013 ()
Title: A Study to Investigate the Effect of Lepodisiran on the Reduction of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Adults With Elevated Lipoprotein(a) - ACCLAIM-Lp(a)
Official title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Investigate the Effect of Lepodisiran on the Reduction of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Adults With Elevated Lipoprotein(a) Who Have Established Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease or Are at Risk for a First Cardiovascular Event - ACCLAIM-Lp(a)
Sponsor: Eli Lilly and Company
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD); Elevated Lp(a)
Interventions: Lepodisiran Sodium (DRUG); Placebo (DRUG)
Start date: 2024-03-05
Enrollment: 17300 (ESTIMATED)
Primary outcome(s): Time to First Occurrence of Any Component of the Major Adverse Cardiac Event (MACE)-4 Composite Endpoint [Baseline up to End of Study (About 4.5 Years)]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have Lipoprotein(a) \[Lp(a)\] ≥175 nanomoles per liter (nmol/L).
* Meet criteria of either 2a or 2b:

  2a: Individuals 18 years of age or older with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) with an event or revascularization.

  2b: Individuals 55 years of age or older who are at risk for a first cardiovascular (CV) event and either: Documented coronary artery disease (CAD), carotid stenosis, or peripheral artery disease (PAD) without history of event or revascularization; known familial hypercholesteremia; or a combination of high-risk factors.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have had a major cardiovascular event or surgery, such as myocardial infarction (MI), stroke or coronary or peripheral revascularization, \< 60 days before screening
* Have uncontrolled hypertension
* Have New York Heart Association class IV heart failure.
* Have lipoprotein apheresis within 90 days of screening, or planned lipoprotein apheresis during the study.
* Have severe renal failure, defined as

  * Estimated glomerular rate (eGFR) \<15 milliliters per minute per 1.73 meters squared (mL/min/1.73m2) at screening Visit 1, or ongoing dialysis.
* Have a diagnosis of active nephrotic syndrome, or urine albumin-creatinine ratio (UACR) of ≥5000 mg/g at screening Visit 1.
* Have acute or chronic hepatitis, known cirrhosis, signs and symptoms of any other liver disease other than metabolic-associated steatotic liver disease, or exclusionary laboratory results as determined by the central laboratory during screening.
Brief summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of lepodisiran in reducing cardiovascular risk in participants with high lipoprotein(a) who have cardiovascular disease or are at risk of a heart attack or stroke. The study drug will be administered subcutaneously (SC) (under the skin). Approximately 1700 additional participants will be enrolled in an addendum to explore Lp(a) lowering with an alternative dosing schema.
Overall status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING
Why stopped: -
Primary completion: 2029-03
Has posted results: False
--- END ---
